metadata.name: [SRE] OpenSearch write threadpool rejected
metadata.description: P2 OpenSearch ThreadpoolWriteRejected > 0 over 15m. Sibling of search rejects.

breach.query:
FROM metrics-aws.cloudwatch_metrics-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| WHERE aws.cloudwatch.namespace == "AWS/ES" AND aws.dimensions.NodeId IS NOT NULL
| STATS rej = SUM(aws.es.metrics.ThreadpoolWriteRejected.sum)
    BY aws.dimensions.DomainName, aws.dimensions.NodeId, cloud.account.id, cloud.region
| WHERE rej > 0
| KEEP aws.dimensions.DomainName, aws.dimensions.NodeId, cloud.account.id, cloud.region, rej
